title: First part of ASAP+ENRP dissector clean-ups
description: Reduced redundancy by moving common definitions and value strings from ASAP and ENRP dissectors into separate files packet-asap+enrp-common.h/packet-asap+enrp-common.c.

added 8 commits

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/2232/diffs?diff_id=150275288&start_sha=bb8d366ac0400c40d487fdbdea0176b934b85257)
